sentences.span: A day after SpaceX went looking for $40 billion in chip-collateralized SPV debt
sentences.why: Every source describes this as SpaceX seeking/looking to raise/in talks for $40bn — a financing search still in progress, never a completed raise. 'Raised' presents an in-progress deal as closed. The crowding-out-of-sovereign-paper framing is separately well supported (19877).
